title: Coordinates of the completed compactification projection
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a simultaneous reduction presentation $m$ [def-pur-compactification-reduction-models]. For a scheme $T$, use the ordinary and whole-system signed tensor symmetries on the recorded flat K-flat representatives [def-pur-ringed-site-signed-tensor-models]. For $f:X\to Y$, a compactification $c$, and integral derived objects $K,M$, define $H=f_R^*K\otimes M$, $V=K\otimes PM$, $D=\widehat f^*K\widehat\otimes M$, and $S=K\widehat\otimes PM$ using [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Define the maps $H\to D$ and $V\to S$ by the published tensor quotient unit and pullback unit. The ordinary coefficient-first projection is the ordinary proper/open projection conjugated by the two signed symmetries; the system coefficient-first projection is defined the same way. For unit isomorphisms $h:H\simeq D$, $v:V\simeq S$, define $\alpha=v^{-1}\pi P(h)$, $q=r(h^{-1})\mu\nu$, and $s=r(v^{-1})\mu(1\otimes b_M)$, where $b$ is exactly reduction of compactificationLimit followed by the actual counit. A system is normalized constructible if its inverse image under derivedTowerEquivalence is a normalized constructible Tor tower [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. These are definitions, with every map retained on entire systems.
